concepts.gloss_en: staff / tribe / rod (aspect of sustenance and the tzaddik's dominion)

reason_for_human: This written form is two distinct words, confirmed by the vocalizations in the proofs. מִטָּה 'bed' (occ 1048, 1051) is explicitly glossed as the aspect of zivug/marital union; מַטֶּה 'staff/tribe' (occ noid_1703 = staff-of-bread/sustenance, occ 1894 = Moses's staff / the tzaddik's power) is a separate lexeme. I kept the two מַטֶּה occurrences together since staff and tribe are one polysemous word (same vocalization), not homographs.
